name: r3-dispatch-encoder-write-faults
_comment: S1 (dispatch r3): a local write failure inside the STREGA encoder (expectation insert, attempt claim, opaque CLOSE_FOR_DURATION journal) publishes a FAILED_RETRYABLE command_ack and answers 503 with the SQLite code; a failing calibration read before the encoder answers 503 with the SQLite code and message and publishes nothing, also for a held valve and a non-16-hex key.

CREATE TRIGGER r3_fault_exp BEFORE INSERT ON valve_actuation_expectations WHEN NEW.device_eui IN ('A840410000000311','A840410000000313') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'r3 expectation fault'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER r3_fault_claim BEFORE UPDATE OF transport_json ON valve_actuation_expectations WHEN NEW.device_eui='A840410000000312' AND NEW.transport_json LIKE '%ATTEMPTED%' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'r3 claim fault'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER r3_fault_opaque BEFORE INSERT ON valve_settings WHEN NEW.device_eui='A840410000000314' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'r3 opaque journal fault'); END;CREATE TRIGGER r3_fault_opaque_u BEFORE UPDATE ON valve_settings WHEN NEW.device_eui='A840410000000314' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'r3 opaque journal fault'); END;
DROP TRIGGER r3_fault_opaque; DROP TRIGGER r3_fault_opaque_u;
